strings.name: Rabindranath Tagore
strings.role: Poet and educator · A major figure in Bengali literature
strings.summary: Tagore was a Bengali poet, novelist, composer, painter and educational practitioner. His poetry and short stories expanded the expressive range of modern Bengali literature, and his poetry won the 1913 Nobel Prize in Literature. He founded a school and an international educational institution, emphasizing exchange across cultures. In 1919, he renounced his British knighthood in protest against the Amritsar massacre.
strings.coverageNote: Selected milestones in literature, education and public action. Dates distinguish Bengali originals from English translations.

strings.highlights.highlight-01.title: 1913 Nobel Prize in Literature
strings.highlights.highlight-01.text: Received international recognition for his poetry, becoming the first non-European writer to win the prize.
strings.highlights.highlight-02.title: Educational experiments
strings.highlights.highlight-02.text: Founded a school at Santiniketan in 1901 and established Visva-Bharati in 1921.
strings.highlights.highlight-03.title: Work across the arts
strings.highlights.highlight-03.text: Created fiction, plays, songs and paintings as well as poetry.
strings.timeline.event-01.title: Dies in Calcutta
strings.timeline.event-01.text: Died aged 80 after a long career in writing, the arts and education.
strings.timeline.event-02.title: Establishes Visva-Bharati
strings.timeline.event-02.text: Built an international educational institution on his earlier teaching experiments, encouraging exchange between cultures.
strings.timeline.event-03.title: Renounces his British knighthood
strings.timeline.event-03.text: Refused to retain the knighthood awarded in 1915, protesting against the Amritsar massacre.
strings.timeline.event-04.title: Receives the Nobel Prize in Literature
strings.timeline.event-04.text: His poetry won the Nobel Prize in Literature, further expanding his international influence.
strings.timeline.event-05.title: Publishes Gitanjali in English
strings.timeline.event-05.text: Collected English translations of selected poems, introducing his writing to more readers outside Bengali.
strings.timeline.event-06.title: Bengali Gitanjali appears
strings.timeline.event-06.text: Published the poetry collection Gitanjali, an important work in his literary career.
strings.timeline.event-07.title: Founds a school at Santiniketan
strings.timeline.event-07.text: Began an educational experiment emphasizing nature, the arts and cultural exchange.
strings.timeline.event-08.title: Publishes Manasi
strings.timeline.event-08.text: The poetry collection Manasi appeared. During this period, life on family estates also brought him into contact with rural society.
strings.timeline.event-09.title: Born in Calcutta
strings.timeline.event-09.text: Grew up in a family that valued literature and thought; received instruction from private tutors and began writing early.
